thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty auto-page fired: INC-5421 for service=runtime-canary. Trigger: canary p95 latency > 2.0s for the last 2m. Link: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/INC-5421

pagerduty: PagerDuty details: severity=high, escalation policy=eng-oncall -> sre -> platform. Alert note: "canary rollout 2026-03-15T03:10Z showing sustained 5xx and tokenization stalls". Auto-escalation in 5m if unacked.

elena: acked via PD. I'm on it, grabbing logs and telemetry. Can someone confirm which release this is (release tag + hashes)?

sam: that's release: rwd-infer-2026.03.15-rc3, kube tag: img:ghcr.io/redwood/runtime:20260315-rc3 (deployed to canary pool). Canary traffic split 10%->90% at 03:05 UTC per rollout plan.

jonas: I'm taking primary. Observing high tail latency from embedder workers during tokenization stage, looks like a quantized kernel path thrash. Pulling a failing request sample.

rohit: Customer-impact note: a small number of customers in eu-west-1 are seeing slow responses and occasional 503s. Support ticket queue has 3 customers reporting timeouts — flagging CSM.

jonas: logs excerpt (from runtime-canary pod runtime-canary-5f7d):
```
[2026-03-15T03:11:08Z] ERROR request_id=abcd1234 step=tokenize duration_ms=2150 model=embed-quant-v2 kernel=kv_quant
[2026-03-15T03:11:09Z] WARN request_id=abcd1234 fallback=kvcache-miss
[2026-03-15T03:11:09Z] ERROR request_id=efgh5678 step=generate status=503
```
Looks like KV cache invalidations spiking and fallbacks to slower codepath.

michelle: Is this reproduced on dedicated or only canary? Telemetry shows backend pods on dedicated stable are fine — seems rollout-specific. Might be an interaction between the new quant kernel and continuous batching thresholds.

elena: Good call. If it's rollout-specific we should immediately stop the canary rollout and divert traffic back to previous version. Suggest: scale down new canary replicas and route the 10% back to stable. sam — can you run the traffic-divert?

sam: On it. Command I'll run: `kubectl -n inference set image deploy/runtime-canary runtime=ghcr.io/redwood/runtime:20260315-rc2 && kubectl rollout status deploy/runtime-canary` and then patch traffic-split. Pasting step: `kubectl apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: split.example/v1
kind: TrafficSplit
metadata:
  name: runtime-split
spec:
  services:
  - name: runtime-stable
    weight: 100m
  - name: runtime-canary
    weight: 0m
EOF`

incident-bot: Action logged: user=sam executed traffic-split patch at 2026-03-15T03:14:32Z.

jonas: After divert, p95 dropped to 420ms for the next 2m window on the canary-bucket metrics. No new 503s observed. Still keeping an eye for residual cache invalidations.

elena: Good. I'm going to open a rollback + postmortem ticket. For immediate mitigation, let's rollback the canary fully (rc2). Sam, confirm when rollout completes and I'll close PD.

sam: Rollback completed at 2026-03-15T03:18:20Z. `kubectl rollout status` shows all canary pods running ghcr.io/redwood/runtime:20260315-rc2. Traffic-split now 100% -> runtime-stable.

pagerduty: Incident INC-5421 acknowledged closed by elena at 2026-03-15T03:19:05Z. Resolution note: canary rollback to rc2; root-cause suspected kv-cache invalidation interaction with new quant kernel, requires follow-up.

elena: Notes for follow-up: assign to eng-ml (quant team) and eng-runtime to investigate kernel path, add reproducible test with kv-cache churn, and hold rc3 until fix. cc: @michelle @jonas @sam.

rohit: Notifying affected customers with a brief status: we reverted the canary and services are stable; root-cause under investigation; ETA for update TBD.

michelle: I'll schedule a canary-gate: add a smoke test to the rollout pipeline that simulates KV cache churn at low QPS and runs quant kernels. Blocking rc3 until tests green.

jonas: Adding logs/trace links here: https://logs.redwood/internal/trace?trace=abcd1234 and perf dashboard: https://dash.redwood/metrics/runtime-canary/2026-03-15-03. Saved export to the incident ticket.

elena: Great work team. Closing thread for now — follow-up ticket: ENG-11234 created for root-cause and mitigation. If anything else pops up, reopen this thread. :white_check_mark:\"
